stem: This World War II poster publicizes a national campaign aimed at —

options.label: A
options.text: creating agricultural projects to relieve an economic depression

options.label: B
options.text: encouraging a healthy diet for future soldiers

options.label: C
options.text: lowering the cost of living by creating a surplus of food

options.label: D
options.text: supporting the war effort by reducing demand for commercially grown food

visual_elements: An image of a World War II poster showing people planting a garden with the text 'PLANT A VICTORY GARDEN' at the top and 'OUR FOOD IS FIGHTING' on a basket of vegetables.
notes: Question references a specific historical poster theme related to World War II victory gardens.
